fields.name: Role
fields.description: Also the portal role: it decides which pages and sections a person sees in the Lab Operations Portal.

fields.name: Is active
fields.description: Untick when someone leaves. Their past work stays linked.

fields.name: Open assignment count
fields.description: Work assignments for this person that are not done yet. A workload indicator.

fields.name: Password
fields.description: Sign-in password for the Lab Operations Portal (with Email). The template’s demo users use "template": before go-live, delete them or give each its own strong password.

fields.name: Contact person
fields.description: Professional contact only. The template stores no patient data.

fields.name: Contact email
fields.description: Receives exception and release emails, and signs in to the portal.

fields.name: Is portal enabled
fields.description: This customer can sign in to the Lab Operations Portal to submit and follow requests.

fields.name: Open request count
fields.description: Service requests that are not closed or cancelled.
fields.formula: count(filter(field('Service request'), and(totext(lookup('Service request', 'Status')) != 'Closed', totext(lookup('Service request', 'Status')) != 'Cancelled')))

fields.name: Password
fields.description: Portal sign-in password for this customer (with Contact email). The template’s demo customers use "template": before go-live, delete them or give each its own strong password.

fields.name: Portal role
fields.description: The customer’s role in the Lab Operations Portal. Customers without portal access can sign in but see nothing.

fields.name: Service code
fields.description: Unique code for each orderable service.

fields.name: Turnaround target (h)
fields.description: Target hours from receipt to released result. Requests take the slowest target of their services as their due time.

fields.name: Is sent to partner
fields.description: Performed by a referral partner laboratory (send-out).

fields.name: Received at
fields.description: When the lab received the request. The turnaround clock starts here.

fields.name: Closed at
fields.description: Set by the release automation when the request closes.

fields.name: LIS/LIMS reference
fields.description: Order number in your LIS or LIMS. External reference only, never patient data.

fields.name: Is information missing
fields.description: Tick when the request lacks information the lab needs from the customer.

fields.name: Hours open
fields.description: Hours from receipt until closed, or until now while the request is open.
fields.formula: date_diff('hh', field('Received at'), if(isblank(field('Closed at')), now(), field('Closed at')))

fields.name: Turnaround target (h)
fields.description: The slowest turnaround target among the requested services.

fields.name: Due at
fields.description: Received at plus the turnaround target.
fields.formula: field('Received at') + date_interval('1 hour') * field('Turnaround target (h)')

fields.name: Received sample count
fields.description: Linked samples that have arrived (not expected or in transit).

fields.name: Open exception count
fields.description: Linked exceptions that are not resolved.

fields.name: Is every sample released
fields.description: Every sample of the request, except rejected ones, has the LIS/LIMS status "Results released".
fields.formula: and(count(filter(field('Sample'), totext(lookup('Sample', 'Status')) != 'Rejected')) > 0, count(filter(field('Sample'), and(totext(lookup('Sample', 'Status')) != 'Rejected', totext(lookup('Sample', 'LIS/LIMS status')) != 'Results released'))) = 0)

fields.name: Customer email
fields.description: The customer’s contact email, for automation emails.

fields.name: Is overdue
fields.description: Past its due time and not closed or cancelled.

fields.name: Is information request needed
fields.description: Information is missing and no open "Missing information" exception is linked yet. The missing-information automation uses it so it never opens the same exception twice.
fields.formula: and(field('Is information missing'), count(filter(field('Exception'), and(totext(lookup('Exception', 'Type')) = 'Missing information', totext(lookup('Exception', 'Status')) != 'Resolved'))) = 0)

views.name: Submit a request
views.title: Submit a service request
views.description: Order lab services for samples you send us. Every request is confirmed by the lab, and its due time is calculated from the turnaround targets.

rows.field_87520: Sent to the partner pathology laboratory. The report was forwarded by courier.
Genetic test: on hold until the signed consent form arrives.
Cancelled: SARS-CoV-2 PCR is discontinued. The practice re-ordered the respiratory virus panel.
Cancelled by the customer before the sample was collected.
Culture on hold: the request form does not say where the wound is.
Liver panel repeated after a failed quality control run.
The requester asked for a phone call as soon as the D-dimer is released.
No clinical details for the urine culture. Asked the practice to complete the form.

fields.name: Sample ID
fields.description: Barcode on the tube or container. Unique by convention.

fields.name: Condition on receipt
fields.description: Anything other than "Acceptable" rejects the sample and opens an exception.

fields.name: LIS/LIMS status
fields.description: Written by your LIS or LIMS through the API (or by hand). "Results released" on every sample readies the release check.

fields.name: Is exception needed
fields.description: Rejected on receipt and no "Rejected sample" exception linked yet. The rejected-sample automation uses it so it never opens the same exception twice.
fields.formula: and(and(totext(field('Condition on receipt')) != '', totext(field('Condition on receipt')) != 'Acceptable'), count(filter(field('Exception'), totext(lookup('Exception', 'Type')) = 'Rejected sample')) = 0)

fields.name: Is request released
fields.description: Every sample of this sample’s request has its results released in the LIS/LIMS.
fields.formula: count(filter(lookup('Service request', 'Is every sample released'), lookup('Service request', 'Is every sample released'))) > 0

views.name: Sample intake
views.title: Register a sample at reception
views.description: Scan the barcode, link the request and record the condition on receipt. A rejected sample opens an exception automatically.

fields.name: Is late
fields.description: Past its due time and not done.

fields.name: Documentation
fields.description: Manuals, service reports and qualification certificates.

fields.name: Days until maintenance
fields.description: Negative when maintenance is overdue.

fields.name: Type
fields.description: Missing information, rejected samples, samples not received and transport delays are customer-facing: the customer is emailed.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: What happened.

fields.name: Is customer notified
fields.description: Ticked by the notification automation once the customer has been emailed.

fields.name: Days open
fields.description: Days since the exception was created; 0 once resolved.

fields.name: Owner email
fields.description: The owner’s email, for automation emails.

fields.name: Customer email
fields.description: Contact email of the request’s customer, for automation emails.

views.name: Report an exception
views.title: Report an exception
views.description: Missing information, a rejected or missing sample, a delay or a customer question: record it here so it gets an owner.

rows.field_87539: Request REQ-00037 is missing information the lab needs to continue. Note on the request: No clinical details for the urine culture. Asked the practice to complete the form.
Northgate asked when the histopathology report will be available.
rows.field_87544: Report date confirmed with the partner laboratory and passed on.

rows.field_87539: STAT samples from the emergency department arrived 40 minutes late because the pneumatic tube was out of order.
rows.field_87544: Hospital facilities repaired the pneumatic tube. Samples were carried by hand in the meantime.

rows.field_87539: Urine for culture arrived at 14 °C after the cool box failed in transit.
rows.field_87544: Replacement sample received in a new cool box the next morning.

rows.field_87539: Coagulation sample arrived in an EDTA tube instead of a citrate tube.
The request form does not say where the wound is. The culture report depends on it.
Signed consent form for the genetic test is missing.
Two microbiology benches are short-staffed this week, so culture reading runs late.
Chemistry quality control failed on the morning run. The liver panel must be repeated.
EDTA tube for HbA1c had insufficient volume.
rows.field_87544: New sample collected at the practice and received the same morning.

rows.field_87539: PCR system 01 is down. Respiratory panels wait for the service engineer.
Lithium heparin sample arrived haemolysed, so troponin cannot be measured. A new sample is needed from the emergency department.
Blood culture box from Hospital on-site lab East is stuck in traffic.
EDTA sample expected with the morning delivery has not arrived.

fields.name: Is released in LIS/LIMS
fields.description: Ticked by the LIS/LIMS sync automation when every sample has its results released, or by hand.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: "Released & communicated" closes the request and emails the customer.

fields.name: Is ready to close
fields.description: Released and communicated, but the request is not closed yet. The release automation uses it so it never closes a request twice.
fields.formula: and(totext(field('Status')) = 'Released & communicated', count(filter(field('Service request'), totext(lookup('Service request', 'Status')) != 'Closed')) > 0)

fields.name: Customer email
fields.description: Contact email of the request’s customer, for the release email.

fields.name: Is temperature OK
fields.description: Untick when the temperature logger shows an excursion.

fields.name: Transit time (h)
fields.formula: date_diff('hh', field('Picked up at'), field('Delivered at'))
